The facts fed.bik.trump_account.employer_contribution_max and fed.w2.box12.code.ta are dated 2026-07-04 (iw2w3 2026: 'Beginning July 4, 2026, employers may contribute up to $2,500'). findings.expected: Render '(effective from 2026-07-04)' after both tags in column D of US-051, and write 'W-2 box 12 code TA (from 2026-07-04)' in AA. The C48 residual is then a checker limit (it requires validity for the whole year): see the escalated finding.

findings.problem: Three blocking content gates fail on correct content, and no agent may write the exemption. C48: TA is valid from 2026-07-04 by statute (P.L. 119-21, iw2w3 2026), and C48 accepts only codes valid for the whole year. C49: KW-100 is the Kansas withholding guide id (US-KSS5-001) in CCG table 206 r11c2, not a wage-type code; confirmed, no WTC change. C50: US-126 quotes ga.sui.base.section125 = 'employer and employee premiums in a Section 125 plan ... are not considered wages', which is the authority wording on which premiums are excluded, not on who bears the tax. The C50 side regex reads it as 'both sides', so the check misreads it and the fact text is right.
